introCard.heading: Why choose Clinique du VR?
introCard.body: Specialized and attentive service for RV modification, Van Life conversion, solar and lithium systems, maintenance and repair. We focus on clear explanations, a practical reading of the vehicle's condition, and recommendations tailored to your actual situation. We have a year-round workshop as well as a mobile unit to serve you better depending on the type of work needed. Speed, transparency, and careful execution from start to finish are part of how we work.

partsStore.heading: RV Parts and Accessories Store
partsStore.body: Visit us for a selection of parts and accessories for RV maintenance, repairs, and upgrades, including solar products. Our team can also help you identify the right product for your vehicle and check its availability.

seoSections.heading: RV service in Gatineau and nearby areas
seoSections.body: Clinique du VR supports owners of RVs, travel trailers, caravans and vans with modification, Van Life conversion, solar and lithium autonomy, pre-purchase inspection, preventive maintenance, water leak repair, roof work and restoration. Our workshop in Gatineau also serves the greater Ottawa region, Outaouais and the Laurentides, as well as selected files elsewhere in Quebec and Ontario.

seoSections.heading: A useful approach before any work begins
seoSections.body: When a vehicle needs more autonomy, a custom interior, Van Life equipment, solar and lithium upgrades, or repair after wear or water intrusion, the first step is to clarify the vehicle's actual condition. We then help you choose between modification, solar, Van Life, inspection, maintenance, repair or pre-sale preparation based on what is most useful.
